附魔力達 54～64 時，把一顆金蘋果放入附魔台，第三格可轉成附魔金蘋果。生存模式須達顯示等級，實際消耗三級經驗與三顆青金石。

At bookshelf power 54–64, the third enchanting-table option converts one golden apple into an enchanted golden apple. Survival players must meet the displayed level; the conversion consumes three levels and three lapis lazuli.

Minecraft 26.2 / Fabric / Java 25. Requires Fabric API and TotemCore >=0.7.18 <0.8.0.
